name: Sella Dellet's Ring
summary: A plain silver ring surrendered to the Censer with the Glimmerborn heir of House Dellet in ~460 Si — 'Dellet's choice' made metal. It is catalogued as a minor effect and stored accordingly, which is to say carelessly, because no one can bear to steal it. The ring's inner band bears a private inscription: 'I will find you when it is safe.' Sella was never recorded again.
origin: ~460 Si — surrendered at House Dellet's sealing
current_whereabouts: The Censer archive, miscatalogued among confiscated jewelry since the Great Collection.
properties: No enchantment, no echo — just silver, an inscription, and what it means
The Dellet estate's eastern wall (now the Censer Quarter) has one stone that is warm on cold nights; no record connects this to anything
keepers: The Censer archive, unknowingly; whoever miscatalogued it spared it from destruction by making it boring.
value_or_danger: Nothing to anyone but a Dellet — or someone who believes Sella kept her word.
adventure_hooks: Players find the ring while researching something else entirely. The inscription's promise is either 1,300 years unkept — or recently kept.
A Stilleven flower-leaver at Solmere's treaty posts wears gloves. Under them: ring-marks.
